title: Figure 18: satellite map of witness lines of sight suggesting possible flight path
description: Google Earth satellite view of central Texas with highway route markers (377, 281, 6, 67, 220), red and yellow lines of sight, a yellow location pin, and green zigzag arrows tracing a possible path. Caption: "Figure 18 (General Reference) photo- Lines of Sights from witness intersect suggesting a possible flight path of the object/light." The page header lists findings sections including "A case for the 3 helicopters and arrays," "A Case for Jets and flares," "A Case for TR-3B" and "A case for the unknown."
